definition.en: The International Telecommunication Union (ITU) is the United Nations specialized agency for information and communication technologies (ICTs).
definition.hi: The International Telecommunication Union (ITU) is the United Nations specialized agency for information and communication technologies (ICTs).

importanceInUpsc.en: For UPSC GS-3, understanding the ITU is crucial as it governs global radio-frequency spectrum and satellite orbits, which are vital for India's digital infrastructure and economic growth. It highlights the intersection of international cooperation, technological standardization, and the digital economy.
